notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. The only lookout-specific sources are a name and county page (source 3), a state list entry (source 2) and an index line marking the tower gone (source 4). Wikipedia (source 1) is used only for community context. No design, build date, staffing, fire or removal record was found, so the story is about 110 words and omits those sections. The Wikipedia community point (32.19111, -94.66528) is several kilometres from the index point (32.20425, -94.73204), so the site's position relative to the community is not established. Possible leads not read: the book Fire in the Piney Woods (Texas lookout towers) and Texas Forest Service records. Recommend a human look before publishing.
